# Nataliia Krasovska — Hair Stylist in Valencia

> Professional independent hair stylist based in Quatre Carreres, Valencia, Spain. Services include children's haircuts and styling, women's and men's haircuts, everyday styling, and special-occasion hairstyles.

## About the Stylist

Nataliia Krasovska is an independent hair stylist based in Valencia, Spain.

She has 10 years of experience in the beauty industry, including more than 3 years specifically dedicated to children's hairdressing.

Her services focus on haircuts and styling for children, women, and men.

## Services

### Children's Haircuts

- Children's fringe trim — €15
- Boy's haircut — €25
- Girl's haircut, up to shoulder blades — €25
- Girl's haircut, below shoulder blades — €30
